gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns the missing restriction that the initial error lie in the homogeneous Dirichlet solution space, causing boundary traces to persist under iteration. ISSUE-001 instead concerns an invalid local coercivity step in a subdomain estimate; its proposed repair does not diagnose the initial-space or trace-invariance defect.

The gold issue is the unsupported extension of a solution-specific approximation estimate to every admissible test function, together with the unjustified replacement of the global norm by an oversampling norm. ISSUE-001 diagnoses a separate local-coercivity failure and does not recognize the missing arbitrary-v construction or quantifier transfer.

The gold issue is that an unspecified partition of unity leaves the experimental eigenvectors, coarse spaces, and preconditioners non-unique. ISSUE-002 concerns a missing bilinear-form factor in an algebraic preconditioner formula and provides no diagnosis of unspecified experimental construction choices.

The gold issue is the omission of the source term f from the 3D experiment, which makes the right-hand side, residual history, and iteration counts non-reproducible. ISSUE-001 concerns local coercivity and convergence-rate proof bounds, with no substantive connection to the missing experimental source specification.
